description: Give part or all of a held deposit back to the client, with the date and how it was sent. Refuses more than is still held. The invoice server is not touched: a refund is not a payment.

amount_minor.description: How much to give back, in minor units. Defaults to everything still held

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the day the money went back. Defaults to today

id.description: Deposit id such as DEP-2026-0001, or an exact client name

method.description: How it was sent, e.g. "bank transfer to the account it came from". Printed on the statement

note.description: Free text kept on the refund row

name: deposit_refund
title: Refund a deposit
